4247-6277-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

4279-5332-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5332-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4770-6006-6090-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-3899-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve both Spawning Pit abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-3899-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

728-856-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

225-851-1308-3129-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1315-3478-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

2946-4871-5147-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4871-5147-7316.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1409-1753-3099-6723.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5933-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3715-4659-4740-6613.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
3715-4659-4740-6613.description:
Cast Power Conduit from your graveyard by paying {2} and 3 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve Power Conduit, causing it to enter with a finality counter on it.
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing the finality counter from it, choosing either of its modes.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Power Conduit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2279-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

4067-4306-6281-7206.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
4067-4306-6281-7206.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 3.
4067-4306-6281-7206.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Dundoolin Weaver.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Dundoolin Weaver that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Dundoolin Weaver token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dundoolin Weaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

647-851-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7154.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

654-2893-3470-4136.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Amulet of Vigor.
When the basic land enters, Amulet of Vigor, Lotus Cobra and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the basic land.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1268-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

4474-5051-5078-5741.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

826-4508-6847.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
826-4508-6847.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, giving Weftstalker Ardent all creature types until end of turn.
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Weftstalker Ardent is a Pirate due to Amoeboid Changeling, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Weftstalker Ardent triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Weftstalker Ardent trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 4.

654-1409-3875-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token. 
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land that entered
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
654-1409-3875-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

1742-2793-3743-5089-6753.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
1742-2793-3743-5089-6753.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

4050-6243-6288.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding one mana of any color.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Infernal Vessel, adding one mana of any color.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel in additional to its other types.
Repeat.

64-101-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-101-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Vampire Charmseeker and Warden of the Eye.
When Vampire Charmseeker and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-101-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

803-1429-5147-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
803-1429-5147-5402.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3869-4067-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness. There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
3869-4067-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat.
3869-4067-5168.notes: If you control a permanent of each color, this combo nets near-infinite mana in any combination of red, white and/or black.

151-950-5261.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
151-950-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

2097-5435-5742-5743.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1621-5361.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Auton Soldier.
1621-5361.description:
Cast Auton Soldier by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2011-4784-5168.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one blue and at least one black permanent.
An opponent cannot block and kill Bloom Tender.
2011-4784-5168.description:
Declare Bloom Tender and any other desired creature(s) as attackers.
Augusta triggers, as well as Najeela for each Warrior that was declared an attacker.
Resolve the Najeela trigger(s), if applicable, creating that many 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Augusta trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

397-851-3868.description:
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing a Treasure, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping the Citizens and Adrix and Nev, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Stimulus Package twice by sacrificing the Treasures, creating four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three Citizens, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

4289-4944-5137.notablePrerequisites: Morphling does not have summoning sickness.
4289-4944-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling's first ability by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Morphling ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

377-1773-2427-2640-4050.notablePrerequisites: Nyxborn Rollicker attached to Nyxborn Shieldmate.
377-1773-2427-2640-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Shieldmate, adding {W}.
Nyxborn Shieldmate leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Rollicker to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Shieldmate from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Shieldmate for its bestow cost by paying {W}, attaching it to Nyxborn Rollicker.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nyxborn Rollicker, adding {R}.
Nyxborn Rollicker leaves the battlefield, causing Nyxborn Shieldmate to become an enchantment creature.
Dawn Evangel triggers, returning Nyxborn Rollicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Nyxborn Rollicker for its bestow cost by paying {R}, attaching it to Nyxborn Shieldmate.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star

933-1494-1747.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours entering the battlefield triggers Remnant of the Rising Star, causing you to pay {5} to put five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
